theme_strategy.rationale: Clean, data-heavy interface prioritizing legibility and precision. Light mode conveys transparency and 'daylight' (solar), while dark mode support is essential for power users.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1). Use 'text-slate-900' on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Implement the 'Bento' grid layout for the main dashboard using CSS Grid.
Use the 'Solar Glow' gradient for primary CTA buttons or active states, but keep the UI mostly clean and white.
Ensure the map component takes up significant screen real estate (split view or full width).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons. Do not import other icon libraries unless necessary.
Use 'recharts' for data visualization (bar charts for energy output, line charts for trends).
Do NOT use generic 'Bootstrap' column layouts. Use asymmetric grids.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic gradients, centered everything).
Micro-animations are mandatory for hover states.
